test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The ministir ordered the engineers to build roads through high mountains and bridges across deep ravines in a week.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ministir"** is incorrectly spelt in the given sentence. The correct spelling should be "Minister". (मंत्री)

 
 
• **Example: **The** minister** will address the nation tomorrow.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ravines **(दर्रे): A deep, narrow gorge with steep sides.

 
 
• **Example:** The village is located near several deep **ravines.**
 
 
 
• **Engineers **(इंजीनियर): Professionals who design, construct, and maintain structures, machines, or systems.
 
 
• **Example: **The** engineers** are working on a new bridge design.
 
 
 
• **Bridges** (पुल): Structures built to span physical obstacles like water bodies, valleys, or roads.
 
 
• **Example:** The city has several beautiful** bridges **over the river.
